meta.title: Michael Lovo · Backend developer
meta.description: Systems engineer from El Salvador. I build microservices and APIs with Node.js, NestJS and TypeScript.

intro.tagline: I build what you don't see.
intro.lead: I'm a systems engineer and I've been writing software for over 3 years. What I enjoy most is the part nobody sees: APIs, queues, databases, and the piece of the system that has to work all the time, even if no one notices it.
intro.body: Today I work at Banco Integral, building the microservices behind the bank's electronic invoicing, about a thousand invoices a day, with Node.js, NestJS and TypeScript.

timeline.title: Where I've been
timeline.intro: Most of my path has revolved around electronic invoicing: first at a hospital, then at a bank.

items.title: Backend Software Engineer, Banco Integral
items.body: I went from consultant to full-time staff. I maintain critical microservices, implement regulatory requirements, and built the goAML integration with centralized authentication and tokens.

items.title: Backend Developer, Consultora Pliret
items.body: From the consultancy, I built Banco Integral's Electronic Invoicing platform and designed its microservices architecture.

items.title: FullStack Developer, Hospital Nuestra Señora de la Paz
items.body: My first electronic invoicing microservice. Using queues and Amazon S3, I made bulk processing ~20% faster. I also built insurance and purchasing modules in React.

items.title: Backend Developer, Suyanet
items.body: An admin system for clinics, with roles and automated deployments using Docker and GitHub Actions.

projects.title: Things I've built
projects.intro: A few of the systems I'm most proud of.

items.title: Electronic invoicing for a bank
items.body: Microservices that issue the bank's electronic invoices and keep them traceable, with RabbitMQ queues and SQL Server.

items.title: goAML integration
items.body: A service that centralizes authentication and tokens to consume regulatory APIs securely.

items.title: Bulk processing at a hospital
items.body: I redesigned invoice processing with queues and Amazon S3 so it could handle large volumes without getting stuck.

items.title: Kubernetes Administration and Deployment: On-premises and AWS EKS
React: From Zero to Expert (Hooks and MERN)

offCode.title: Away from the code
offCode.body: When I'm not coding, I'm probably playing video games (Fortnite, most of the time) or watching a stream. And when it's time to step away from the screen, I go play basketball.

contact.title: Want to grab a coffee?
contact.body: If you want to talk backend, architecture, or you have a project in mind, drop me a line. I always reply, ideally over coffee.
